engine.notes: Washington improv centers on WIT, which leaves its Studio Theatre residency for a permanent NoMa home in January 2027, with the DC Improv's school as the other full ladder in the District. The Unified Scene Theater's and the Highwood Theatre's sites no longer resolve; Round House's Silver Spring education center and Theatre Lab list adult classes but no improv course.

entries.name: Washington Improv Theater
entries.area: Logan Circle (Studio Theatre), moving to NoMa in 2027
entries.summary: DC's nonprofit long-form improv theater, founded 1998, in residence at Studio Theatre and building a permanent home in NoMa for January 2027, with five core levels to the Harold, free workshops, weekly Harold Night and a show season.
entries.schedule: Harold Night free Mondays 7:30 and 8:30pm, jam 9:30; show runs September 25 to October 25; free workshops monthly
signals: Five core levels from Foundations to Harold
Free weekly Harold Night and jam
Free monthly workshops in every DC ward
Permanent home opening January 2027 in NoMa
entries.reasons: Twenty-eight years, the region's deepest class ladder, a free weekly show and jam, and a dated season; the only thing missing is the building, which opens in 2027.

entries.name: DC Improv Comedy School
entries.summary: The comedy school inside the DC Improv club on Connecticut Avenue, with improv courses from Beginning through Level 2, Advanced and Long Form Creation in five-to-six-week terms, graduation shows and a monthly improv jam.
entries.schedule: Beginning Improv starts October 5 and 10; advanced courses from November 8; 'Can I Get a Yes And' improv jam October 14
signals: Improv levels from Beginning to Long Form Creation
Visiting masterclasses, David Razowsky November 3 to 8
entries.reasons: A permanent club, a dated multi-level improv track and a jam, scored below WIT because improv shows are showcases inside a stand-up venue.

entries.name: Reflex Improv
entries.area: Arlington, with classes across Northern Virginia
entries.summary: A Northern Virginia improv school teaching six-week Intro, Level 2 and Level 3 courses plus Harold, Bat and Armando format classes and musical improv in Arlington, Reston, Fairfax, Falls Church, Chantilly and Annapolis.
entries.schedule: Six-week courses, $230 in Arlington and $275 elsewhere; fall terms run late October to mid-December
signals: Classes in Arlington and five other towns
Intro, Level 2, Level 3 and format classes
entries.reasons: A clear ladder with dated terms close to Arlington, but a school without a theatre, so shows are student performances.

entries.name: Little Theatre of Alexandria
entries.summary: A community theatre founded 1934 with its own playhouse on Wolfe Street, whose adult class programme includes improv courses taught by Sarah Holt and Keely Kirk, registered each term through Active.
entries.schedule: Fall 2026 adult classes open for registration
entries.reasons: A permanent home and current adult improv classes, but improv is one strand of a drama school with no improv shows.

entries.name: Dojo Comedy
entries.summary: A Columbia Heights improv and sketch school with a six-step improv track from a free Level 0 to a Level 5 Harold course, three sketch-writing levels, house teams and shows.
entries.schedule: Classes currently registering; dates by enquiry
signals: Improv Levels 0 to 5, ending in the Harold
entries.reasons: A complete written curriculum in a Metro-accessible neighborhood, but the site shows no class dates, address or show calendar.
